artifact:
Use-Case: UC-001 - Verify Clock Overflow
Actor: Software Tester
Main Flow:
1. Set up the software environment to run the clock for 2 weeks.
2. Monitor the clock output to ensure it does not overflow.
Alternative Flow:
2a. If the clock overflows, record the overflow event and notify the development team.
Exception Flow:
2b. If the software does not have a clock, terminate the test and report the issue to the development team.

Use-Case: UC-002 - Verify Numeric Stability Over Time
Actor: Software Tester
Main Flow:
1. Run the numeric algorithms continuously for 2 weeks.
2. Monitor the stability of the algorithms to ensure they do not lose stability.
Alternative Flow:
2a. If the algorithms lose stability, record the instability event and notify the development team.
Exception Flow:
2b. If the software does not have numeric algorithms, terminate the test and report the issue to the development team.

Use-Case: UC-003 - Verify Stress Testing in Faster Than Real Time
Actor: Software Tester
Main Flow:
1. Set the software to run in faster than real time mode.
2. Run the software for 2 weeks in this mode.
Alternative Flow:
2a. If the software fails to run continuously for 2 weeks in faster than real time mode, record the failure and notify the development team.
Exception Flow:
2b. If the software does not support faster than real time mode, terminate the test and report the issue to the development team.

Use-Case: UC-004 - Verify Power Efficiency for Continuous Operation
Actor: Software Tester
Main Flow:
1. Set up the software to run continuously from battery power.
2. Monitor the battery life to ensure it lasts for at least 1 hour.
Alternative Flow:
2a. If the battery life is less than 1 hour, record the battery life and notify the development team.
Exception Flow:
2b. If the software does not have power efficiency features, terminate the test and report the issue to the development team.

Use-Case: UC-005 - Verify Inspiration Detection
Actor: Software Tester
Main Flow:
1. Simulate patient inspiration within the software.
2. Verify that the software correctly detects the patient inspiration.
Alternative Flow:
2a. If the software fails to detect patient inspiration, record the failure and notify the development team.
Exception Flow:
2b. If the software does not have the capability to detect inspiration, terminate the test and report the issue to the development team.
